findings.problem: The now/other arms render « à l’instant » at 11 cells (rich.cells.cell_len), against the sidecar’s advisory maxCells=6. This is idiomatic French, but not the most compact natural sidebar notation. The actual renderer uses a shrink-0 row-time span, not a six-cell hard clip: the extra width competes with the title. No rendered clipping is claimed. « 0 min » is a natural compact elapsed-time notation: the caller selects now only when elapsed whole minutes are zero (also for future clock skew). « récent » is shorter but loses the precise just-now meaning, so is not recommended.

findings.problem: In the hour/many and year/many arms, « de heures » and « de ans » omit mandatory elision. IntlMessageFormat(fr) actually renders these malformed phrases for count=1000000. Use « d’heures » and « d’ans ». Non-blocking here: the actual elapsed-time selector never emits a million hours (hours switch to days at 24), and a million years lies outside JavaScript Date’s supported range; ordinary reachable copy is unaffected.
